claim: Form 137 is the Secondary Dependency Application, OCT 2024 edition
quote: PREVIOUS EDITION IS OBSOLETE. DD FORM 137, OCT 2024

claim: The form recognizes a non-spouse, non-biological-child dependent
paragraph: Page 3 table, Incapacitated Adult Child and Student rows
fix: Incapacitated and student children include biological children. Say the form recognizes secondary dependents: a child 21 or older, a ward, a parent, parent-in-law, stepparent or in-loco parentis.

claim: Approval supports BAH, USIP card and travel allowance
quote: Basic Allowance for Housing (BAH) not to exceed full BAH with dependents, Uniformed Services Identification and Privileges Card (USIP), travel allowances

claim: The OCT 2024 form covers seven dependency types, student age 21 to 22 among them
fix: Table rows: incapacitated adult child, student, ward, parent, parent-in-law, stepparent, in-loco parentis.

claim: Over-half financial support test applies to every type
quote: Sponsors must provide more than one-half (50%) of the claimed individual’s support.

claim: Worksheet on pages 5 to 7 substitutes for a prior-year tax return
quote: please complete and return Worksheet for Determining Financial Support with your DD137

claim: Purpose quote from the Privacy Act statement
quote: determine the relationship and dependency of the claimed dependents and determine the member’s entitlement of authorized benefits

fix: The form is a DoD form controlled by DFAS and prescribed by DoD 7000.14-R Volume 7A Chapter 26. Set publisher to DFAS.

claim: Sponsor completes sections 1 through 8 and signs section 9
S-1 reviews, routes to IPAC, IPAC routes to the HQMC Dependency Determination Section
quote: Headquarters Marine Corps, DEERS and Dependency Support Section (MFP-1)
fix: The adjudicating office is the DEERS and Dependency Support Section (MFP-1). The IPAC step is not in either text. Name MFP-1 and cite MCO 1751.3 chapter 1 paragraph 12.

claim: In-loco parentis claims add DFAS Form 9124 and two DFAS Form 9125 from non-relatives
quote: DFAS Form 9124 (Affidavit by member) and DFAS Form 9124 (Affidavit by claimed dependent) and Two DFAS Form 9125
fix: The form requires two Form 9124 affidavits, one by the member and one by the claimed dependent, plus two Form 9125 third-party affidavits. A package with one 9124 is incomplete.

claim: Approval triggers DEERS enrollment, a BAH adjustment through MCTFS and a RAPIDS appointment
quote: Unit diary actions for secondary dependents can only be accomplished by the CMC (MFP-1)
fix: Neither source describes a RAPIDS appointment sequence. State MFP-1 completes the unit diary action and cite para 11.

claim: Parents, parents-in-law, stepparents need residence for the USIP card. In-loco parentis never get one. BAH and travel carry no residence requirement
quote: In-Loco Parentis are not eligible for USIP benefits, but member/sponsor may claim for purposes of BAH and other eligible travel allowances.

claim: Every approved case recertifies annually per MARADMIN 661/19 with an updated form and Worksheet
quote: CMC (MFP-1) will initiate the annual recertification for all Secondary Dependents.
fix: MARADMIN 661/19 is Manpower Audit Advisory 1-19 and sets no annual cycle. Cite MCO 1751.3 chapter 1 paragraph 8. MFP-1 starts the recertification, so drop the promise of an updated form and Worksheet.

claim: Filled-in form is CUI under the PRVCY category
Governing authorities are DoD 7000.14-R Volume 7A Chapter 26 and MCO 1751.3
MCTFSPRIUM 12-0103 directs units to submit DD Form 137-6 to CMC (MFP-1) to retain a dependent child past age 21
quote: Starting 1 July 2025 Headquarters Marine Corps, DEERS and Dependency Support Section (MFP-1) will no longer accept the following obsolete forms
fix: The PRIUM text still names DD Form 137-6, but MFP-1 rejects it since 1 July 2025. Direct units to submit DD Form 137 (Oct 2024) and note the PRIUM text lags.

claim: externalUrl points at the DoD forms library PDF
fix: Direct form PDF on esd.whs.mil. The Status section calls it a form page. Shape acceptable.
